auth.routes.ts: Authentication endpoints (login, register, verify) — must be public by design
role.routes.ts: Uses router.use(authenticate) at the top; role management has its own access controls
permission.routes.ts: Permission listing — requires auth but not branch scope (global reference data)
practice-group.routes.ts: Platform-level group management — uses requireRoles('Admin') directly, not branch-scoped
public-booking.routes.ts: Patient-facing booking — public by design, no PHI exposed
seed.routes.ts: Empty router, not mounted in production
portal.routes.ts: Patient portal — uses its own authentication (portal tokens), not staff branch scope
appointment-type.routes.ts: Reference data — appointment types are global, not branch-specific
coverage-group.routes.ts: Reference data — coverage groups are global configuration
coverage-template.routes.ts: Reference data — coverage templates are global configuration
form-template.routes.ts: Reference data — form templates are global (no ClinicNum, no RLS)
insurance-company.routes.ts: Reference data — insurance companies are shared across all branches
insurance-plan.routes.ts: Reference data — insurance plans are shared across all branches
language.routes.ts: Reference data — languages are global configuration
medication.routes.ts: Reference data — medications are global configuration
membership-plan.routes.ts: Reference data — membership plans are global configuration
note-template.routes.ts: Reference data — note templates are shared configuration
procedure-code.routes.ts: Reference data — procedure codes are global (ADA codes)
shortlist.routes.ts: Reference data — shortlists are global configuration
branch.routes.ts: Branch management — uses authenticate but not branch scope (manages branches themselves)
user.routes.ts: User management — uses authenticate and its own scope checks via assertUserInScope
